scenes.text: One tag. A live jackpot on your page. This is the drop-in jackpot widget from iPlay Games.

Normally, putting a live jackpot in front of players is a front-end project. A socket feed to keep the number moving. A countdown. A leaderboard. A layout that survives a phone. And then the same work again for the next brand.

With iPlay Games it is a web component. Load the widget script, drop in the element, and set five attributes: your domain, your token, which jackpot, the theme, and the currency. That is the integration.

The widget handles the rest. It opens the websocket connection, keeps the prize pool updating in real time, and renders the interface for you. Prize pool, must-drop progress, participants, minimum bet, winners, and a live leaderboard. Customisable, and mobile-ready.

And the jackpots themselves are yours. In the back office you configure casino and network jackpots, progressive or must-drop, with contribution rates, automatic payouts and real-time tracking. Set it up once there, and the tag on your page shows it live.
Want this running on your own jackpot? Book a walkthrough with our team at iplaygames dot A I. One tag, live jackpot. iPlay Games.
